entry.title: Most Developers Quit Projects Too Early
entry.summary: One thing I’ve noticed in the developer world is how many projects get abandoned too quickly. A developer gets an idea. For the first few days, progress feels fast and motivating. Then reality hits. Bugs appear. And that’s the moment when many projects quietly die. But the difference between a finished product and an abandoned project is usually not skill. It’s persistence. Almost every useful tool or product went through a phase where building it felt slow, messy, and frustrating. The developers who succeed are often just the ones who keep going when the excitement fades. Because most projects don’t fail due to bad ideas. They fail because people stop building. 🚀

entry.title: I Built a Telegram Channel That Monitors 14 Pokémon News Sources Every 15 Minutes
entry.summary:
If you're into Pokémon, you know the pain. News drops across a dozen sites — Serebii, PokeBeach, PokeJungle, NintendoLife, Dexerto — and by the time you check them all, you've already missed something. So I automated it. A Telegram channel called Pokémon News Pulse that aggregates news from 14 different sources and delivers it every 15 minutes. One feed, everything you need. Here's everything it monitors: Dedicated Pokémon Sites: Serebii.net (scraped — no RSS available) PokeBeach.com (scraped — RSS blocked) PokeJungle PokePatch Pokémon GO Hub Gaming News (filtered for Pokémon): Dexerto NintendoLife NintendoEverything ScreenRant IGN Kotaku Polygon GameSpot Search Queries (SearXNG): "Pokémon news today" "Pokémon TCG Pocket news" "Pokémon GO update news" "Pokémon Legends news" "Pokémon games announcement" "Pokémon anime news" Every 15 minutes, a Python script: Pulls the latest stories from all 14 RSS feeds Scrapes Serebii and PokeBeach directly (they block RSS) Runs 6 search queries to catch anything RSS missed Filters mainstream sites — only Pokémon-related stories pass through Deduplicates by title hash — no repeats Only posts stories from the last hour — always fresh Extracts article images for visual posts Posts to the Telegram channel with source links 🎮 Game announcements and updates 🃏 TCG Pocket and card game news 📱 Pokémon GO events, raids, community days 🎬 Anime and movie updates 🏆 Competitive VGC and tournament results Every post includes the headline, a brief description, an image from the article, and a direct link to the source. Instant delivery — push notifications as news breaks No algorithm — you see everything, in order Free — no subscription, no ads Clean — one story per message, no clutter t.me/PokemonNewsPulse — join and you'll start getting updates within 15 minutes. We also run channels for other topics: 🤖 AI & Tech News
🌍 World News
